name: Affiliate registrations
description: Creates an affiliate conversion when a new user account self-registers while carrying an affiliate cookie.
project_description: Affiliate Registrations is a submodule of Affiliated that attributes new user registrations to affiliates. It implements hook_user_insert and, when a genuinely anonymous self-registration carries a valid affiliate cookie, creates a user_registration affiliate_conversion attributed to the referring affiliate with the new user as the conversion's parent entity. Admin-created accounts (where the current user is authenticated) are not tracked. Ships the user_registration conversion type. Part of the affiliated project (version dir 1.0.x, 1.0.0-alpha).
